journey.name: App Launch and Home Screen
journey.description: Verifies that VidFlow launches successfully without crashing and displays the Home screen with all platform shortcuts and search controls.

actions.action: Verify that the app does not crash and the process remains active
Verify that the Home screen is displayed
Verify that platform shortcuts (YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, Pinterest) are visible
Verify that the URL input and paste actions are visible and interactive
Verify that the bottom navigation bar displays Home, My Files, and Settings tabs
